title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above at an angle. A red sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; a gold raised disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the red token to the gold goal square. The shortest route takes 4 moves.
game.hint: Steps to goal = rows apart + columns apart. Every move toward the goal lowers it by 1.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Start and goal are always the same; Reset returns the token to the same start and clears the move count. The board has no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal.
